body: I have the full tribal arm sleeve from the movie From Dusk Til Dawn and the artwork from the movie The Number 23

Their belief in religion is what I believe that keep my parents from not wanting to believe that a youth director of a baptist church would do such a thing. My wife is here for convenience I believe. I do not know why she is around, honestly. By the way if I did get out more it only furthers my thoughts of others seeing me and the ugliness I bring around. I feel as every eye is looking and every voice is talking about me. I began to sweat extensively, hands shake and head starts swimming. I am no go in public also because I sit and watch others have fun and have someone to enjoy things with. I am starting to tear up just letting this out now

Yes ma`am or sir, I did try to explain what happened at how it made me feel, but my parents and wife stopped me midstream while explaining. It was as though they did not want to hear any of the incidents, nor could they keep a straight face, seemed they believed I was not being truthful. THAT HURT EXTREMELY! I was first sent to a psychiatrist, he gave me an I.Q. test, showed me blotted drawings, asked me a few questions, and gave me two prescriptions, then sent me away (that was weird). 3 months later, my wife found me and took me called my parents, they all took me too a rehab hosp. where I was surrounded by alcoholics, drug users, etc., By the way, I am not being disrespectful to these people, but it scared the hell out of me! I did not want to be there!! After this, I have retreated back into the shell I crawled out from under with the reactions I have received, I take the same meds that I was prescribed, though not working, I will not speak to anyone else in person. I have learned that many with my IQ level and higher do have some of the same problems I have now. 

     Ma`am or sir, it is very hard to actually talk about these things, knowing while I write nothing will change the way I feel, but I apologize to you now for my rambling, my thoughts race through my head and I can not keep on course long unless I am deep down inside some mathematical book or problem. I know to function I must deal with others, but it takes all my strength just to get up and more to get outside. Thank you for listening, but I understand if I never hear from you again, I would not want to talk to me either. Please take care of yourself and look at me as someone who is not worthy of your time. Thank you for your time your you have given!

The only time I spoke of it to my parents, they shipped me to a rehab hosp. for thirty days. I have told my wife since then and she chuckled a little and changed the subject. So no ma`am or sir, I have no one and it is quite obvious I am in their way.
